purpose: Cloud-intelligence gateway view of the tenant env-tier model-default and per-tier cost-budget contract. This is metadata-only Plan/Spec/RED evidence and does not implement provider dispatch, billing, production traffic, or runtime enforcement.

admission_order: admit to provider pool only after all metadata checks pass

failure_behavior.missing_per_tier_cost_budget_evidence: 429 budget_exceeded or policy denial before provider dispatch
failure_behavior.foundry_live_authority_resurrection: deny and route to intelligence retirement-authority fix-forward, never to a foundry runtime

usage_evidence.emits_after_admission_only: llm.usage.v1 metadata may be emitted only after env-tier and budget metadata have admitted the request; failed admission emits denial/budget metadata without provider token counts.

serialization_requirements: cloud/cloud-intelligence/contracts and manifest refs serialize with gateway provider/budget contract lanes
runtime budget admission must wait for tenancy env-tier API/Cedar runtime endpoint completion and review
cloud-ci tenant-environment-tier packet remains separately serialized
generated *.generated.json must not be hand edited
